description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per lookup - the payment buys one signed settlement verification for the one transaction signature you name: the service reads the chain live and returns the verdict (SETTLED-MATCH, SETTLED-MISMATCH with the mismatching field named, NOT-FOUND, PENDING, or FAILED) with the fields as found and an as-of timestamp. The looked-up transaction content is never stored.

expected.description: The expected settlement fields: payTo (wallet), amountUnits (USDC micro-units), and optionally tokenAccount and memo.

signature.description: The one Solana transaction signature to verify. Read live from the chain at call time; never stored.

name: settlement_verify
